alarme.amtlich.label: Official warnings trigger an alert
alarme.radar.label: Rain alert (radar)
alarme.metriken.keine_gewaehlt: Select metrics in the Weather tab to configure alert thresholds.
alarme.metriken.nur_ohne_alarm: None of the selected metrics can trigger an alert: {namen}. They still appear in the briefing but do not trigger a warning.
alarme.metriken.ohne_alarm: There is no alert for these metrics: {namen}. They still appear in the briefing but do not trigger a warning.
alarme.kanaele.einleitung: Alerts are short instant notifications — {kanaele} are ideal for them. The planned briefing (the table) continues separately over its own channels.
alarme.kanaele.nicht_im_abo: Switched off in the alert channels: {kanaele}. The choice is saved anyway.
alarme.kanaele.metrikfrei_hinweis: Radar and rain alerts as well as official warnings always use the alert channels, not the choice per weather variable.
alarme.kanaele.wind_hinweis: A wind change alert follows the channel choice of the gust or the wind row, depending on what triggered it.
alarme.kanaele.nicht_verfuegbar: Channels per weather variable are currently unavailable. The alert channels apply.
alarme.kanaele.kein_empfaenger: {kanal} has no recipient — these alerts will not arrive there. Add it in the Delivery tab or in your profile.
alarme.kanaele.schwelle_hinweis: {kanal} has the urgency threshold "{schwelle}" — weaker warnings will not arrive over this channel.
alarme.premium_sms.tarif_wird_geprueft: Checking your level — the channel cannot be switched for a moment.
alarme.cooldown.hinweis: Minimum gap between two alerts for the same metric — prevents spam from fluctuating values.
alarme.stille_stunden.hinweis: Do not send alerts in this period (local time {zonen_bezug}) — queued alerts go out with the next morning briefing.
alarme.stille_stunden.mitternacht: Quiet hours across midnight ({von} to {bis} of the next day).
alarme.tabelle.leer: No alertable metrics active. Select metrics in the Weather tab.
alarme.alarm_ab.umbau_hinweis: Alerts now follow the traffic light. You set ‘Alert from’ in the Weather tab.
alarme.richtwert: Guide value — converted per weather model and area
alarme.vorschau.keine_metriken: No alert-capable weather metrics active. First activate weather metrics (e.g. wind gusts, temperature) in the {link} tab.
alarme.vorschau.nach_speichern: The preview with real data is available after saving.
alarme.vorschau.keine_orte: No locations configured yet — add candidates in the {reiter} tab.
alarme.vorschau.regel_aktivieren: Activate at least one alert rule to load the preview.
